Dear Service Coordinator / RC,
I am writing to inform that we are moving the case
0477738
﻿from the Technical Support to the
eMobility RC-DE SI E Queue
. We kindly ask you to take over the case and perform the necessary troubleshooting steps.
Customer: Bauer Netz GmbH
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
MP / R5 170001871
Charger ID / Serial No.:
ta8hFv
Charger address/functional location:
Priority:
Low
Handover reason: I am handing over this ticket to your queue because the charger is
out of warranty
and 1h free support has been provided from TS side.
Customer opened the ticket to report sporadic "Unavailable" status on both outlets on charger
MP/R5 170001871.
He provided us with excel files reporting timestamps of unavailable status since 2023.
I analyzed the last 2 events he reported, and these are my findings:
On 10.02.2026, DC2 was reported twice as "Faulted" due to the following error:
2026-02-10T06:33:44.532076+00:00 [FW080005G1] sicharge-cp [local0:info] ecog-secc-adapter/c3fc57362708[826]: Outlet is offline, comm outage: 5001 ms
2026-02-10T06:18:42.547844+00:00 [FW080005G1] sicharge-cp [local0:info] ecog-secc-adapter/c3fc57362708[826]: Outlet is offline, comm outage: 5001 ms
I would recommend to u
pdate the charger to v8.1.4 and update it to v9.0.X as soon as it is released
.
On 27.01.2026, DC1 went outoforder #2 times, both for just 3 seconds, but in the logs I cannot find any reason why. Once at 2026-01-27T03:48:43 and once at 2026-01-27T03:29:54. I would not focus on these instances.
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the
eMobility RC-DE SI E Queue
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under Documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require Expert Support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Kindly close the case post resolution following the case handling guidelines.
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
Siemens AG
eMobility Customer Service
Technical Support Engineer

Nonnendammallee 101
13629 Berlin, Germany
